contents.name: Sections 1–2.1: finite-output expectation and classical sampling context
contents.reason: Provides the Monte Carlo setting and expectation target; the variance, independence and Chebyshev argument is proved completely from the declared finite-probability suppliers.

contents.name: Lemma 1 (Powering lemma)
contents.reason: Motivates finite median amplification; the exact one-sided Bernoulli tail and constants are proved locally from the named probability and calculus suppliers.

contents.name: Algorithm 1 and Theorem 3: estimating a bounded mean by amplitude estimation
contents.reason: Supports the bounded-mean construction context; the unique QA13 circuit and guarantee remain the actual estimator interface and are not duplicated here.

contents.name: Section 2.2, Algorithm 2 and Lemma 4: positive bounded-L2 mean estimation
contents.reason: The dyadic decomposition and L2 error profile are scaffolded as a local lemma with complete tail, concentration and resource proofs.

contents.name: Section 2.3, Algorithm 3 and Theorem 5: variance-aware mean estimation
contents.reason: The finite centering, positive/negative split, repetition schedule and separately charged access routine are explicitly defined; its accuracy and cost are proved locally.

contents.name: Theorem 5 resource coordinates: state copies and state reflections
contents.reason: The variance-aware error and resource bounds are derived from the local positive-mean and one-sided median suppliers with exact access assumptions.

contents.name: Inverse preparation and reflection access in the quantum algorithms
contents.reason: The access requirements are stated as supplied unitary interfaces and costs; unresolved QC source readiness is separately recorded in the cross-batch input.
